UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION - CORRIGENDUM
Notice Ref: 01/2026-ENGG-CORR
Date of Release: 28 January 2026

In partial modification of Examination Notice No. 01/2026-ENGG dated 05 January 2026,

the following amendments are hereby notified:

1. The last date for submission of online applications is extended from 18 February 2026 to 28 February 2026 (6.00 PM
2. The application fee is reduced from Rs. 200 to Rs. 150 for General candidates.

3. All other conditions remain unchanged.

Website: https://upsconline.nic.in
